title: NLP Progress in Indigenous Latin American Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Bibliometric analysis of the ACL Anthology to quantify the representation and under-representation of Indigenous Latin American languages in NLP research, measuring the number of publications per language, country, and specific NLP task to highlight the bias toward high-resource languages.

Conducting a comprehensive survey of NLP researchers and indigenous community members to evaluate systemic neglect, marginalization, the prevalence of Western concepts/Anglicisms in technology, and the lack of indigenous involvement in the AI research process.
